extent: All 34 ordered displayed catalogue fields, LDR through SYS, including repeated 562 and 650 fields and FMT/PSP/SYS local fields; not a machine-exported MARC21 record.
transformation: Extract every two-cell data row from the complete HTML table id=record; decode HTML character entities, strip display markup and collapse HTML layout whitespace to single spaces inside each cell; preserve order, displayed field/indicator labels and literal subfield separators. No correction of catalogue text or missing-leaf arithmetic. Excludes navigation, software, JavaScript, catalogue wrapper, CSS, footer and session URLs.
